subject: Borealis Bank - Procurement & Onboarding next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@borealisbank.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@borealisbank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Borealis Bank - Procurement & Onboarding next steps

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use case: payment reconciliation and fraud alert enrichment for corporate FX flows.
- Anticipated monthly tokens: ~150M input tokens, peak latency SLO of ~150ms for interactive routes.
- Decision criteria: latency, cost predictability (committed vs burst), and security controls (SOC2, VPC options).

Stakeholder mapping (as discussed):
- Economic buyer: Tom Lee (Finance) — budget / PO approvals
- Procurement / Vendor Ops: vendor-onboarding@borealisbank.com
- Security / InfoSec: Samira Khan (shared insights on SOC2 / architecture)
- Legal: contract redlines go to laura.bennett@redwood.ai (I copied our legal lead for coordination)

Immediate asks we flagged on the call (what we can provide this week):
1) Vendor onboarding packet (attached): SOC2 summary, security overview, and our vendor onboarding form.
2) PO/invoicing details: who to send W9/PO to and billing address — please confirm.
3) Procurement timeline: rough go/no-go window and any internal milestones (security review dates, procurement committee date).

Next steps / proposed owners:
- Marissa (me): share security docs + vendor onboarding form (attached). Coordinate with your procurement contact for PO flow.
- Rishi (SE): available for a short technical follow-up to map integration and latency expectations — suggest 30 mins next week.
- Monica (Finance, cc): will handle invoicing and billing questions once we have PO details.
- Samira: will confirm security checklist items and any evidence you require beyond SOC2.

Could you confirm the correct procurement contact and whether Borealis requires a W9 / specific vendor ID? Also, what's the typical PO lead time at your org for new vendors?

Attached: Redwood_Security_OVERVIEW.pdf; SOC2_Report_2025.pdf; Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the onboarding form if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@borealisbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@borealisbank.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Borealis Bank - Procurement & Onboarding next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the summary and attachments. A few items from procurement side: 

- Please send a completed W9 and the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO (we need that for vendor creation).
- Our standard payment terms are Net 30 after invoice unless otherwise negotiated. Can Redwood accept Net 30? 
- Billing address / remit to: Borealis Bank Accounts Payable, 120 Market St, Suite 700, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- Vendor onboarding contact: vendor-onboarding@borealisbank.com (cc'd here). They will send the portal invite once we provide the initial vendor packet and completed onboarding form.

Also, what is Redwood's standard lead time between PO issuance and production access for Dedicated/Private deployments? We want to understand the timeline for procurement vs. security review.

Tom
Director, Vendor Management | Borealis Bank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@borealisbank.com>, vendor-onboarding@borealisbank.com, Samira Khan <samira.k@borealisbank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Borealis Bank - Procurement & Onboarding next steps

Tom — thanks, this is super helpful. Answers below and a couple of items for your vendor ops team: 

1) W9 & Legal entity
- I'll attach our completed W9 and confirm legal entity name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (attached).

2) Payment terms
- Redwood can accept Net 30 for customer POs. For clarity, for reserved/dedicated commitments we typically invoice monthly against the committed amount. Monica (cc) will be the point on invoicing and can share invoice templates.

3) Billing / Remit to
- Please send the PO to: invoices@redwood.ai and include the billing address you listed. Monica will confirm receipt and vendor setup once the PO is in your system.

4) Vendor onboarding portal / timeline
- We uploaded the vendor packet and vendor onboarding form here: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Borealis-Vendor-Onboarding (link above).
- Typical internal timeline: once vendor ops issues the portal invite and vendor is created (2-5 business days), procurement PO issuance typically takes 3-10 business days depending on approval level.
- For Dedicated deployments: after PO + SOC2 review + network setup, customers typically go live in ~3-4 weeks. If you need acceleration we can prioritize the initial capacity and align SE time.

5) Additional evidence
- Samira: we've included our SOC2 report and a concise security overview. If you need any architecture diagrams, network allowlist details, or evidence of key management practices, let us know and Rishi will prepare them.

Proposed quick next steps:
- Vendor ops (vendor-onboarding): send portal invite and any internal vendor ID requirements.
- Tom: confirm PO owner + estimated approval date.
- Samira: list any extra security artifacts you need within this week so we can prioritize.
- Rishi: happy to do a 30-min technical mapping next week — propose Wed 18th at 10am PT if that works.

Attachments added: Completed_W9.pdf, Redwood_Security_OVERVIEW.pdf, SOC2_Report_2025.pdf, Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Filled.xlsx

Thanks — looping in our finance and legal leads to streamline the PO and contract steps.

Best,
Marissa

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@borealisbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@borealisbank.com>, vendor-onboarding@borealisbank.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Borealis Bank - Procurement & Onboarding next steps

Marissa / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the docs. I've reviewed the SOC2 summary and the vendor onboarding form. A couple of quick items: 

- We will request the portal invite today and begin vendor creation. Expect the invite from vendor-onboarding@borealisbank.com.
- Our InfoSec team may request an architecture diagram and an allowlist for the VPC endpoints — can Rishi prepare those?
- PO timeline: target vendor creation + PO issuance by 11/27; that would put a soft target for provisioning in early December.

Confirming that Net 30 is acceptable and that invoices should go to invoices@redwood.ai. Please assign a single Redwood point for contract redlines so our legal team has one thread to track.

Samira
Sr. Information Security Manager | Borealis Bank
